tagline: Software engineer specializing in full-stack MERN development and multi-service systems.
bio: I am a software engineer with a strong academic foundation in Computer Science from Sindh Madressatul Islam University, graduating with a 3.7 CGPA. My core technical grounding spans data structures, object-oriented design, and database systems, which I apply to architect clean, scalable multi-service solutions including deterministic recommendation systems and role-based access-control platforms.

Complementing my computer science background, I have hands-on engineering experience across the MERN stack as well as Java, C/C++, and PHP. Through my internship at 10Pearls, NAVTTC-affiliated training at NextSkill, and IBM professional certification, I build production-grade web applications utilizing rigorous testing with Mocha and Chai, code quality analysis via SonarQube, and modern Git workflows.
